the suppressor tRNA can insert tyrosin at the nonsense site but it can also propagate across a repeated termination sequence and form polypeptide chain as directed by the repeated UAG codons.
the translation of tandem amber termination sequences can be directed by the purified suppresser tRNA.
the mechanism of termination of protein synthesis by the nonsense codon UAG (amber) is not understood.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of polypeptide termination.
the mechanism of translation termination and its regulation by suppressor tRNAs.
the mechanism of polypeptide-chain termination.

the mechanism of polypeptide termination is a consequence of a specific tRNA recognition of the U-A-G termination codon, and that the mechanism of suppression is a consequence of the recognition of the U-G-A termination sequence by the suppressor tRNA, and not by the termination codon.
the mechanism of termination of polypeptide synthesis is the same for the natural UAG codon and the artificial amber suppressor tRNA.

the tRNAtyr suppressor can translate a tandem amber termination codon in a polytyrosine synthetic direction.
